newsitem.title: INDIA: India SAIL bond issue closes early - paper.
newsitem.headline: India SAIL bond issue closes early - paper.

text.p: Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) closed its 5.0 billion rupee bond issue on the first day after an overwhelming response, the Business Standard newspaper said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said SAIL's issue -- which was due to close on May 15 -- received a positive response from large investors.
The bonds of India's largest steelmaker, priced at a semi-annual coupon rate of 14.5 percent, were snapped by banks, institutions and provident funds soon after the placement opened on Monday.
The newspaper quoted sources saying that SAIL collected 4.35 billion rupees and said that the company had commitments for another 700-800 million rupees.
